root_cause.detail: audit_receipt_valid() reads HEAD through the module alias engine_git_capability(repo) at run-wave-program.py:2318 and never calls git(). The 4 maintained tests monkeypatched controller.git, so the patch was a silent no-op.
root_cause.consequence: tmp_path is not a Git repo, so git_capability() returned has_head=False and the gate correctly took its documented 'No Git/HEAD' branch (return not recorded_head), which is False when a candidate SHA is recorded.
